function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT SUM(pl.amount_cad - (pl.qty * pl.contract_unit_price * pl.fx_rate)) AS excess_other_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
WHERE pl.period = '2026-09'
  AND pl.vendor_id <> 'VEND-SNC'","purpose":"Total excess CAD for vendors other than VEND-SNC in September 2026"}
